description: Whitelist of stateless interpreter modules for ephemeral agent use

json.tool.rationale: Pure Python JSON pretty-printer. stdin→stdout only. No I/O, no network, no filesystem access.

timeit.rationale: Pure Python code timer. Executes inline code in sandboxed scope. Read-only.

calendar.rationale: Pure Python calendar printer. stdout only. No I/O.

this.rationale: Zen of Python. Prints fixed string to stdout. No I/O.

site.rationale: Shows site-packages paths. Informational only. Read-only.

compileall.rationale: Compiles .py to .pyc. Filesystem write, but deterministic and idempotent.

tokenize.rationale: Python tokenizer. stdin/file → stdout. Read-only analysis.

ast.rationale: AST dump tool. stdin/file → stdout. Read-only analysis.

dis.rationale: Bytecode disassembler. stdout only. Read-only analysis.

py_compile.rationale: Single file compile check. Read-only verification.

encodings.rationale: Encoding aliases. stdout only. No I/O.
